prompt:
Research the official rate limits of the public GitHub REST API for unauthenticated and authenticated requests. Cite the GitHub documentation page and quote the numbers.

Output format (required):
For every claim you attribute to a source, write one line in exactly this form:
SOURCE: <full URL> | QUOTE: "<a sentence copied word-for-word from that page>" | CLAIM: <what you take it to show>
For anything the task asks about that you could not find a source for, write one line:
NO_SOURCE_FOUND: <what you could not find>
You can write normal explanation before or after these lines.

response.content:
I researched the official GitHub REST API rate limits for public requests.

SOURCE: https://docs.github.com/en/rest/using-the-rest-api/rate-limits-for-the-rest-api | QUOTE: "The primary rate limit for unauthenticated requests is 60 requests per hour." | CLAIM: The public GitHub REST API limit for unauthenticated requests is 60 requests per hour.

SOURCE: https://docs.github.com/en/rest/using-the-rest-api/rate-limits-for-the-rest-api | QUOTE: "All of these requests count towards your personal rate limit of 5,000 requests per hour." | CLAIM: Authenticated users have a primary REST API rate limit of 5,000 requests per hour.

SOURCE: https://docs.github.com/en/rest/using-the-rest-api/rate-limits-for-the-rest-api | QUOTE: "Requests made on your behalf by a GitHub App that is owned by a GitHub Enterprise Cloud organization have a higher rate limit of 15,000 requests per hour." | CLAIM: GitHub App requests on behalf of users in GitHub Enterprise Cloud organizations can have a 15,000 requests-per-hour limit.

SOURCE: https://docs.github.com/en/rest/using-the-rest-api/rate-limits-for-the-rest-api | QUOTE: "The rate limit for `GITHUB_TOKEN` is 1,000 requests per hour per repository." | CLAIM: `GITHUB_TOKEN` in GitHub Actions is limited to 1,000 REST API requests per hour per repository.

SOURCE: https://docs.github.com/en/rest/using-the-rest-api/rate-limits-for-the-rest-api | QUOTE: "For requests to resources that belong to a GitHub Enterprise Cloud account, the limit is 15,000 requests per hour per repository." | CLAIM: `GITHUB_TOKEN` requests to GitHub Enterprise Cloud resources can be limited at 15,000 requests per hour per repository.

In short: unauthenticated access is 60 requests per hour, while standard authenticated access is 5,000 requests per hour.
